ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High dominance of high-intensity white pixels (approx. 85%) vs. low-intensity black perimeter and focal spots (approx. 15%).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white occupies the central and proximal regions of both lobes. Continuous low-intensity black banding follows the trailing edge and distal tips. Discrete low-intensity focal spots (5-10 pixels) are mapped to the lower-central region of the left lobe and near the notch on the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped depression with a calculated vertex angle of approximately 50-60 degrees, partially occluded by water surface at the apex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern. The right lobe trailing edge exhibits high-amplitude jagged peaks (approx. 15-20 pixels depth), while the left lobe exhibits a more uniform, lower-amplitude serration profile.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex leading edge trajectory tapering to acute distal tips; trailing edges follow a generally concave arc with localized irregular deviations.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Single distinct vertical linear disruption of yellowish-brown hue located on the upper-mid quadrant of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extreme irregular serration/tissue loss on the distal third of the right lobe trailing edge compared to the more symmetrical left lobe. Multiple small, dark circular pigmentation marks/scars scattered across the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Prominent yellowish-brown vertical streak on the right lobe, distinct from natural black/white pigmentation patterns.
